Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back for the Chase. The players and umpires are making their way out in the middle. Jemimah Rodrigues and Smriti Mandhana walk out to bat for India Women while Jannillea Glasgow will start off with the ball for West Indies Women. Here we go...
…THE RUN CHASE…

Deepti Sharma was the pick of the bowler for India Women as she ended with 3 for 11 in her 4-over spell. Rajeshwari Gayakwad was economical and took 1 for 9 in her spell. Pooja Vastrakar capped off with a couple of wickets at the backend to complete an excellent all-round effort by Women in Blue. This should be an easy chase for India Women. The pitch looks difficult to bat on due to dampness on the pitch. India will be the favorite but might struggle to score freely. But Stay tuned as we shall be back with India’s reply shortly.

A sorry-looking batting card for West Indies Women. The innings never got going as they labored their way to end at 94 for 6 in the 20 overs. Hayley Matthews was the only standout batter with 34 off 34 balls. Zaida James on debut struggled at the of her innings but hit two huge sixes and showed glimpses of her power game. She ended with an unbeaten 21 off 31 balls to take West Indies Women over the 90-run mark. A below-par effort with the bat by Women in Maroon.

OUT! TAKEN! Lands it fuller and on off, Aaliyah Alleyne looks to pull it but mistimes her stroke completely. She gets a thick top edge on the follow through. It lobs in the air and Deepti Sharma settles under at mid off to take a dolly. West Indies Women end their innings for 94/5.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Aaliyah Alleyne hangs back and pulls it away, through square leg for  boundary!
On a length and on off, Zaida James tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
On a length and on off, Zaida James miscues her stroke as the ball lobs in the air. Pooja Vastrakar runs to take it but misses on her dive forward. Close!
Fuller and on off, Zaida James lofts it towards long off. It falls just short of the fielder as the batters collect two.
Shorter one, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Wide! Bowls it wide outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne lets it be.
A slower full toss, outside off, Zaida James misses her stroke.
Full and on off, Aaliyah Alleyne drives it to covers for one.
Lands it on off, Zaida James tucks it to short mid-wicket for another quick single. The fielder misses her shy at the bowler's end.
Slower one on off, Aaliyah Alleyne pushes it to short covers for a quick one.
Good length again, Zaida James pulls it to mid-wicket for one more.
On a length and outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne hangs back and punches it to point for one.
Fuller and on off, Zaida James blocks it to the right of the bowler.
SIX! Up, up and over. Fuller and on off, Zaida James prods forward and lofts it over long on for a maximum. That came from nowhere!
Bowls it on off, Zaida James defends it back.
Lands it on off, Aaliyah Alleyne eases it to mid on for one.

OUT! STUMPED! Excellent glovework from Yastika Bhatia here and Deepti Sharma continues to glimmer. This one lands outside off, tuning in, Shabika Gajnabi is beaten on the outside edge as Yastika Bhatia stumps her, and Shabika Gajnabi is late to get her foot back in. The umpire raises his finger and Shabika Gajnabi makes her way back.
Commentary.Howout: st Yastika Bhatia b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Tosses it up, turning in, Shabika Gajnabi blocks it to the off side.
Full and on the stumps, Zaida James makes room and carves it to covers. A dot to end the over.
Back of a length around off, Zaida James gets on top and tucks it to the onside.
Wide! Short and down the leg. Zaida James leaves it alone.
Short of a length outside off, Shabika Gajnabi uses her feet and cuts it to a short third region. The fielder throws it quickly at the striker's end but Zaida James just makes it.
Fuller-length on off, Shabika Gajnabi drills it back to the bowler.
Short of a length on the leg stump line. Zaida James advances to pull and misses, wears on her ribs, and scampers for a leg bye.
Back of a length around off, Zaida James drops it back onto the pitch.
Length ball down the leg, Wide signaled. Zaida James leaves it alone.
Slower and short outside off, Zaida James mistimes the pull to square leg for one.
Short and goes over the left shoulder of the batter, umpire calls it Wide.
SIX!! SMOKED! Full and on off, Zaida James gets down and clubs it over the long-on boundary for a biggie. This has come out of nowhere.
Short and outside off, Shabika Gajnabi cuts it to deep point for one.
Short of a length outside off, Zaida James runs it down to the third man for one.
Fuller delivery around off, Shabika Gajnabi uses her feet and hits it down to long-on for one.
Fuller ball outside off, Shabika Gajnabi moves across and looks to play the ramp, but misses it completely.
Tossed up on off, Zaida James presses forward and defends it to cover.
Length delivery on the stumps. Shabika Gajnabi plays the reverse to short third for one.
Length ball around off, Zaida James gets on one knee and mistimes the sweep to square leg for one.
Full and on off, Shabika Gajnabi swings hard and drills it down to long-on for one.
Length ball around off, Shabika Gajnabi tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Shabika Gajnabi uses her feet and works it to point.
Tossed up again on stumps, Zaida James presses forward to defend and wears on the pad. Another appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
Tosses up on the stumps, Zaida James attempts the reverse sweep and misses it. An appeal from Deepti Sharma but is turned down.
Full ball outside off, Zaida James pushes it to off-side.
Zaida James attempts the sweep again and misses it completely.
Tossed again on the stumps, Zaida James misses out on the sweep shot.
Tosses it up and turns outside off, Zaida James lets it go to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, Zaida James rides on the bounce and drops it to short third for a single to get off the mark.
Full on the stumps, Zaida James plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up again, and goes on with the angle. Skids on past the outside edge of Zaida James.
Full and outside off, Zaida James looks to sweep and misses it.
Tossed up on the stumps, Zaida James presses forward and defends.
Tosses it up outside off, Shabika Gajnabi chops it to cover for one.
Short ball around off, Zaida James pulls as the ball lands just behind the keeper and goes on a bounce to first slip. Excellent over from Pooja Vastrakar.
Length delivery outside off, Zaida James leaves it alone.
Zaida James walks in.

OUT! GONE! Pooja Vastrakar gets the big fish as HayleyMatthews departs. Short of a length outside off, Hayley Matthews mistimes the pull straight in the air as keeper Yastika Bhatia runs around and takes it nicely. West Indies Women lose their 4th as Hayley Matthews walks back for 34.
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Length and angling down the leg. Hayley Matthews tucks it off her pads to the keeper who dives to her left and stops the ball. No run.
Full and going down the leg, Hayley Matthews looks to flick and misses. No wide given.
Peach! Back-of-length delivery swings late after pitching, Hayley Matthews looks to play off the back foot and gets beaten.
On a length outside off, Shabika Gajnabi looks to run it down and misses again.
Back of a length outside off, Hayley Matthews works it to deep backward point for one.
Slower ball on off, Shabika Gajnabi waits for it and drops it to onside for a quick single.
Length ball outside off, Shabika Gajnabi looks to run it down to third man and misses at it.
Short of a length outside off, Hayley Matthews cuts it to deep backward point for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length angling down the leg. Hayley Matthews tucks it past the short fine fielder as the ball races to the fence for four. Easy pickings.

Time for Drinks. West Indies Women have scampered their way to 46 for 3 at the halfway mark. India Women's bowlers have been on top. West Indies Women skipper Hayley Matthews holds the key here and needs to bat deep to take her side to a competitive total.
FOUR! Bowls it outside off, Shabika Gajnabi slashes it over point as the ball races away the fence like a rocket.
Good length, angling in, and some extra bounce. Shabika Gajnabi fends it back.
Bowls it outside off, Hayley Matthews steers it to backward point for one.
On a length and outside off, Shabika Gajnabi opens the face of her bat and guides it to short third man for one.
Bowls it outside off, pace off, Shabika Gajnabi blocks it to the off side.
Fuller and on off, Hayley Matthews drives it to deep covers for one.
Lands it fuller and on off, Shabika Gajnabi defends it back.
Shabika Gajnabi walks in.

OUT! PLUMB! This one lands on middle and skids through, Djenaba Joseph is beaten on the bounce and misses her block as the ball gets rapped on her pads. A loud appeal and the finger goes up immidiately. The batter seems unhappy with the decision as the replay shows there was an inside edge. Unlucky!
Slightly shorter, on off, Hayley Matthews taps it to short covers and calls for one. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A direct hit would have been closer!
Another one outside off, Djenaba Joseph guides it to gully and scampers for a quick single.
Lands it fuller and on off, Hayley Matthews drives it to deep covers for one more.
Slightly shorter and on middle and leg, Djenaba Joseph nudges it to square leg for one.
Fuller, on off, Hayley Matthews sweeps it from the toe end of her bat towards deep square leg for a brace.
A lot quicker and outside off, Hayley Matthews tries to cut it but gets beaten.
Slower through the air, on middle, Hayley Matthews blocks it solidly.
Lands it on leg, Djenaba Joseph tickles it to short fine leg for one.
Turning away from outside off, Djenaba Joseph looks to slap it but gets a bottom edge as the ball bounces towards the point fielder.
Slightly shorter, turning away, Hayley Matthews punches it to the point fielder.
Devika Vaidya comes into the attack now!
Fuller and on off, Djenaba Joseph lunges and blocks it to the point fielder.
Drifting it from outside off, turns away on the bounce, Djenaba Joseph misses her stroke.
Bowls it on off, Djenaba Joseph taps it back to the left of the bowler.
Keeps it bowling fuller in length, Djenaba Joseph plays it uppishly towards the woman at mid off. Luckily, it didn't carry!
Bowls it fuller, keeps it low, Djenaba Joseph eases it to mid on.
Fuller one, on off, Djenaba Joseph lunges and blocks it to short covers.
Flighted up, on off, Hayley Matthews taps it to the woman at mid-wicket.
Slightly shorter one, some turn as well, Hayley Matthews blocks it back.
FOUR! Wonderful timing on this. Flighted up, on off, Hayley Matthews shimmies down the wicket and drives it through the left of mid off for a boundary!
Bowls it fuller, keeps it on off, Hayley Matthews eases it to mid off. Three dots now!
Landsi t on off, Hayley Matthews blocks it back to the left of the bowler.
Turning in from outside off, Hayley Matthews looks to block it but gets rapped on her pads. A stifled appeal but perhaps doing down leg.
Back of a length around off, Djenaba Joseph tucks it to onside.
Length delivery comes in sharply, Djenaba Joseph plays the wrong line and gets wrapped on the pads. A huge appeal but was turned down by the umpire.
Length delivery on off, Hayley Matthews works it to mid-on for a single.
FOUR! The width on offer and capitalized! Short and outside off, Hayley Matthews cuts it aerially through the point region for four more.
Back of a length around off, Hayley Matthews defends it to point.
EDGY, and FOUR! Length ball swings late into the batter, Hayley Matthews gets an inside edge on this one as the ball rolls away to the fine leg region for four.
Slower through the air, Djenaba Joseph gets a leading edge and nearly plays it back to the bowler. A double wicket maiden for Deepti Sharma.
Tossed up outside off, Djenaba Joseph presses forward and blocks it out.
Djenaba Joseph walks in. Deepti Sharma is on a hat trick now.

OUT! GONE! 2-in-2 for Deepti Sharma. An action replay of the previous dismissal. Tosses this up again well outside off and Shemaine Campbelle takes a stride forward to defend but leaves a small gap between bat and pad. The ball finds its way to hit the top of the middle stump.

OUT! GONE! CLEANED UP! Deepti Sharma tosses it up and the ball turns in. Rashada Williams goes for the drive and misses. The ball goes in between the bat and pad gap and cleans her up. West Indies Women lose their first. Shemaine Campbelle walks in next.
Tossed again and turns into the batter, Rashada Williams looks to tuck into the onside but misses and wears on the pad.
Tossed up outside off, Rashada Williams pushes it to covers.
Deepti Sharma comes into the attack.
Length again around off, Rashada Williams tucks it to deep square leg for one.
On a length again around off, Hayley Matthews walks at the bowler and works it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! CUT AWAY! Length ball outside off, Hayley Matthews goes back and cuts it through the backward point region for a boundary.
Length ball around off, Hayley Matthews drives it to point for none.
Length delivery shaping into the batter, Hayley Matthews prods at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full and outside off, Hayley Matthews goes for the drive and gets beaten.
Back of a length around off, Rashada Williams gets behind the line and defends.
Length and angling down the leg, Rashada Williams tucks it to the fine leg region and the batters scamper for a couple.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Rashada Williams has a go at it and edges it to the third man region for a boundary.
On a length outside off, Rashada Williams chops it to cover-point for one.
Length and around off, Rashada Williams looks to play on the onside. Gets a leading edge that falls short of cover.
Length and angling down the leg, Rashada Williams lets it go. Wide signaled.
Length delivery outside off, Hayley Matthews cuts it to deep point for one.
Length ball on the stumps, Hayley Matthews tucks it to mid-wicket for one. Shikha Pandey to share the attack from the other end now.
Length and going down the leg, Wide signaled.
Length ball around off, Hayley Matthews prods forward and defends.
Back of a length delivery around off, Rashada Williams tucks it to deep square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Length delivery shaping away this time, Rashada Williams pushes at it and lets it go at the last moment to the keeper.
Fuller delivery shaping into the batter, Rashada Williams defends it to square leg.
Renuka Singh starts off with a full ball coming into the batter, and Hayley Matthews pushes it to mid-wicket for one.

We are all set for the game to begin. But first, both teams line up for their respective national anthems. It will be India's first, followed by the national anthem of the West Indies. Right then, we are done with the pre-match proceedings. The umpires have made their way out in the middle. India Women players are seen in a huddle, near the ropes. Hayley Matthews and Rashada Williams are the openers for West Indies Women. Renuka Singh to start from this end. Here we go...

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Hayley Matthews (C), Aaliyah Alleyne, Shemaine Campbelle, Shamilia Connell, Afy Fletcher, Shabika Gajnabi, Jannillea Glasgow (In for Chedean Nation), Trishan Holder (In for Shakera Selma), Zaida James (In for Stafanie Taylor), Djenaba Joseph (In for Chinelle Henry), Rashada Williams (WK).

India Women (Playing XI) - Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harleen Deol, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Devika Vaidya, Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Shikha Pandey, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Renuka Singh (In for Radha Yadav).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of India Women. They will BOWL first.

West Indies Women, on the flip side, haven't been competitive enough in this series. A few of their players have shown glimpses but they will have to show a complete team effort to challenge the India Women. WI skipper Hayley Matthews has been the top run-getter in this series with 91 runs to her name averaging over 45. Shamilia Connell has been tidy with the ball. Can West Indies Women show some fight or India Women roll over them with ease? We shall find out. Toss and team news coming up shortly. Stay Tuned!

India Women will use this game as an opportunity to try out fringe players and asses their game plans before the T20 World Cup. Their last game against SA was abandoned due to rain. Smriti Mandhana found some form against WI in their previous encounter while skipper Harmanpreet Kaur too got among runs. Deepti Sharma has been the pick of the bowlers with 5 scalps to her name.

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of the 6th Game in the Tri-Series. It's India Women taking on West Indies Women in today's encounter coming from Buffalo Park in East London. India Women have already qualified for the finals against South Africa Women while West Indies Women were unable to seal their spot and have been knocked out.

It is time now for the 6th and final group game of the Women's Tri-Series in South Africa. It will be India Women taking on West Indies Women at Buffalo Park in East London and even though this game might seem like a dead rubber it isn't. Sure, India Women and South Africa Women have already qualified for the final but with the Women's T20 World Cup on the horizon, this is a crucial game for West Indies Women. The Women from the Caribbean haven't found much form in this series and their fairly inexperienced side has been outplayed by both the other teams. But, skipper Hayley Matthews will look to rally this young side and hope that they put their best foot forward going into the T20 World Cup and a win here might do wonders for them. On the other hand, India Women have been simply sensational thus far in this series and even though their dress rehearsal for the final against the hosts was a washout last time around, they will look to do the double over West Indies Women and take that momentum into the final. There might be a shuffle in their playing XI though for this game and they would want to test their bench strength which is a welcome thing before the T20 World Cup but once again Smriti Mandhana and Harmanpreet Kaur will be key for them with the bat. Two teams who will be eyeing victory but for completely different reasons and it sure looks like to be an enthralling encounter. Who are you backing?
